headline: Valero (VLO) Stock Looks Reasonable On Cash Flow But Rich On Earnings
summary: After a very strong five year run that has seen Valero Energy deliver a cumulative return of 449.3%, the stock now sits at a point where recent momentum and mixed valuation signals are rubbing against each other. At the latest close of US$312.90, the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to a price that is roughly in line with the market, while earnings based multiples screen the stock as looking expensive.
